description: Declarative 12-layer DAG for album creation. Each layer specifies its dependencies, the approval gate, the mmx_action that produces it, and which output_table it writes. Consumed by db/pipeline.py to answer: 'can layer X run for album Y?' and 'what's the next runnable layer?'.
_note_status: DRAFT — review before Day 2 of v3.2 plan
_note_unlocks: Q29c (locked 2026-07-29): declarative DAG, not imperative scripts

layers.description: 5-sentence artist profile. Pulled from M08_artist + walkthrough decisions.
All lyrics for all tracks. Halts at STEP 1.5 for user approval of all lyrics BEFORE any music generation.
Lock final lyrics per track. Quality scoring. Mark is_current=1, set is_locked=1.
Generate all audio via mmx music generate. Halts at STEP 1.7 for user approval of all composed prompts BEFORE any music API call.
Apply loudnorm two-pass per track, embed ID3 metadata, gapless-stitch album sequence. NOT a music API call — pure ffmpeg + mutagen.
Generate cover art via mmx image_generate. 3 candidates, user picks.
Generate cassette J-card sticker using the cassette-mesh template. SVG-based.
Press release, bio, fact sheet, hi-res photos. Markdown + image.
T-shirt designs, poster variants, bundle artwork.
Generate video storyboards (mp4) for 1-3 tracks. mmx video_generate.
Cover variants for Instagram square, Twitter header, Spotify Canvas-style loops. Pre-save campaign assets.
Move superseded versions to _OLD/, generate INDEX.md, mirror to OneDrive, prepare DSP submission package (DDEX XML if full-dsp, or zipped folder for manual upload).

execution_model.checkpoint_strategy: halt after each L4 prompt-set approval, each L6/L7/L9/L10/L11 candidate approval, L8 final approval, L12 finalize
execution_model.retry_policy: Q28: never auto-retry. User clicks [retry] or [skip].
execution_model.resume_strategy: SQLite-backed. Restart picks up at last completed layer.

approval_gates_explained.L1: Approve 5-sentence artist profile. Can edit inline.
approval_gates_explained.L2: Approve all lyrics for all tracks. Can request edits via chat.
approval_gates_explained.L3: Lock final lyrics. Last chance to edit before music generation.
approval_gates_explained.L4: Approve all composed prompts. Per-track: re-generate / approve / skip.
approval_gates_explained.L5: Auto-master. User sees summary; can override loudness target.
approval_gates_explained.L6: Approve cover art from 3 candidates. Can re-roll.
approval_gates_explained.L8: Approve press pack. Can edit text inline.
approval_gates_explained.L12: Final sign-off. Generates _OLD/INDEX.md, mirrors to OneDrive.
